title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator takes AI notes of in-person meetings
summary: The briefing's licensing, default availability, prerequisites and control routes are supported. Remove the unsupported assertion that these sessions have no organiser, cite the separate Android roadmap item, and acknowledge the Android preview already listed in Microsoft's release notes.

claims.claim: Roadmap item 560318 is Rolling out.
claims.quote: "status": "Rolling out"

claims.claim: The roadmap release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.claim: The roadmap target is October CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "October CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap supplies no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant) and GCC.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)", "GCC"]

claims.claim: The roadmap platform is Teams and Surface Devices.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Teams and Surface Devices"]

claims.claim: The roadmap products are Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) and Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)", "Microsoft Teams"]

claims.claim: Facilitator takes AI-powered notes of in-person meetings on Teams Rooms on Windows without requiring a scheduled or hybrid meeting.
claims.quote: This enhancement allows teams meeting in a physical room to capture real-time notes, decisions, and action items—without requiring a scheduled or hybrid meeting.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: Users start each note-taking session by selecting Take notes on the Teams Rooms console.
claims.quote: During an in-person meeting, users can start AI-powered notes by selecting the Take notes button on the Teams Rooms console.

claims.claim: Facilitator generates real-time notes, summaries, decisions and action items, with notes shown on the front-of-room display or touch board.
claims.quote: Notes appear on the front-of-room display or touch board during the meeting: ... The Facilitator agent uses AI to generate real-time meeting notes, summaries, decisions, and action items based on in-person meeting content.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The default is on: the feature becomes available automatically once licensing and prerequisites are met, without additional admin enablement.
claims.quote: The feature is available automatically once licensing and prerequisite configurations are met.- No additional admin enablement is required beyond existing settings.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: In-person note-taking is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Facilitator in Teams Rooms for in-person note-taking is in preview and is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Each Teams Rooms device resource account needs a Teams Rooms Pro licence for this feature.
claims.quote: Pre-requisite: Assign a Teams Rooms Pro license to each resource account you have for your Teams Rooms devices

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: The feature's Learn page still describes in-person note-taking as preview, unlike the supplied GA roadmap and notice.
claims.quote: Facilitator in Teams Rooms for in-person note-taking is in preview and is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.

claims.claim: Learn warns that the preview experience may change before final release.
claims.quote: Preview features might not be complete, and the experience and licensing model may change before final release.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; What's changing; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn warns that the licensing model may change before final release.
claims.quote: Preview features might not be complete, and the experience and licensing model may change before final release.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The cited Learn pages state no separate per-use meter, credit rate or price for in-person notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms in person notes per use pricing meter credits Teams Rooms Pro. Opened rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and rooms/rooms-licensing; both describe licensing without an in-person-notes meter, credit rate or price.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Allow or Block controls organisational Facilitator availability.
claims.quote: select Teams apps > Manage apps. ... Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell exposes app-state management through Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -IsBlocked $true.
claims.quote: This cmdlet updates app state and app available values for the Microsoft Teams app. ... Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -IsBlocked $true

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Facilitator is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default.

claims.claim: Blocking all apps for the organisation also blocks Facilitator.
claims.quote: However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: Learn documents organisational or group-scoped Facilitator availability using an app permission policy.
claims.quote: Follow the instructions at Use app permission policies to control user access to apps to create a new app policy for Facilitator. You can then assign the policy to your entire tenant or to a select group of users.

claims.claim: Facilitator must be enabled for room resource accounts, explicitly including them when availability is scoped to People and Groups.
claims.quote: Enable Facilitator app for the room resource account in the Teams admin center. If app availability is set to Everyone, the room account is included. If availability is scoped to People and Groups, include the Teams Rooms resource account.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription controls meeting transcription.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. ... Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the named meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.where: controls[1].note; Scope; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Turning on meeting transcription is a setup prerequisite for Facilitator in Teams Rooms.
claims.quote: Step 2: Turn on transcription for meetings

claims.claim: Learn describes transcription as both a per-organiser and per-user policy setting.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: The cited documentation does not specify which account's transcription policy applies to an in-person session started from the room console.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in Teams Rooms transcription policy resource account AllowTranscription. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms, meeting-transcription-captions and excerpts of rooms/copilot-admin-mtr; none identifies the policy account for this unscheduled session.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for the Teams IsLoopEnabled setting.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center user interface Teams. Read loop/loop-components-configuration; its admin-center checkbox controls Loop workspaces, while Teams IsLoopEnabled is documented through SharePoint PowerShell.

claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled is tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: Running Set-SPOTenant requires the SharePoint Online administrator role.
claims.quote: You must be a SharePoint Online administrator to run the cmdlet.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables collaborative meeting notes in Teams.
claims.quote: Collaborative meeting notes in Teams | SharePoint PowerShell | Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled ... [Teams-only] Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for the Teams IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled setting.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center user interface Teams. Read loop/loop-components-configuration and facilitator-teams; both prescribe SharePoint PowerShell for this setting, not a portal path.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is tenant-wide and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The Facilitator page says disabling IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled turns off AI-generated meeting notes for all users.
claims.quote: You can manage this control using the IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled setting in PowerShell. ... if you disable this setting, AI-generated notes for meetings is turned off for all users in your organization.

claims.where: controls[2].note; controls[3].note; Scope; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The notice names IsLoopEnabled and IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled as prerequisite Loop settings.
claims.quote: Verify Loop components are enabled:- IsLoopEnabled- IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled

claims.where: controls[4].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The per-room control is Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.where: controls[4].api; Governance controls table; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a scripting or API operation for the Pro Management portal Take notes button setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Facilitator Show Take notes button PowerShell API configuration; Teams Rooms Pro Management device settings API TakeNotes Take notes Facilitator. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and searched rooms/xml-config-file; no operation found.

claims.claim: Show Take notes button on the home screen is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Show Take notes button on the home screen. The default setting is enabled.

claims.claim: Facilitator turns on transcription during the meeting.
claims.quote: Facilitator only turns on transcription during the meeting.

claims.claim: The meeting is not recorded.
claims.quote: The meeting won't be recorded.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: At the end, participants select Save notes and ensure names are added so those participants can access notes and transcript later.
claims.quote: At the end of the session, select Save notes and ensure participants’ names are added in the dialog pop-up so they can access the notes and transcript later on their personal devices.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Unsaved notes are deleted after the session ends.
claims.quote: Unsaved notes are deleted after the session ends.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Saved notes and transcript are accessed in the Teams desktop meeting chat titled Meeting with [conference room name], under Recap > Notes.
claims.quote: navigate to the Teams meeting chat titled “Meeting with [conference room name].” At the top of the meeting chat, select the Recap tab, and then select Notes to find the AI-generated notes and transcript.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Facilitator stores these AI notes as a Loop file in tenant-owned SharePoint Embedded storage.
claims.quote: Facilitator stores AI-generated notes as a Loop file in SharePoint Embedded storage that belongs to the tenant and users who saved the notes can access it later.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The notes data is treated as meeting transcript data.
claims.quote: The data is treated as meeting transcript data.

claims.claim: The notice says no meeting data remains stored or cached on the room device after the meeting ends.
claims.quote: No meeting data is stored or cached on the Teams Rooms device after the meeting ends.

claims.claim: The notice says accessing notes requires adding a work account with Access notes on the console.
claims.quote: Access to notes requires adding your work account using the Access notes button on the Teams Rooms console:

claims.claim: Only participants who add their names at the beginning of the session are identified and attributed.
claims.quote: Currently, only participants who add their names at the beginning of the meeting session will be identified and attributed, provided that they have enrolled their profiles.

claims.claim: Participant identification and attribution also require enrolled profiles.
claims.quote: provided that they have enrolled their profiles.

claims.claim: People who are not identified can still have their speech captured without attribution.
claims.quote: Facilitator only turns on transcription during the meeting. ... Currently, only participants who add their names at the beginning of the meeting session will be identified and attributed, provided that they have enrolled their profiles.

claims.claim: Muting the room microphone prevents Facilitator or transcription from capturing content.
claims.quote: You can mute the microphone in the room to ensure Facilitator or transcription doesn't capture any content.

claims.quote: "id": 560700; "title": "Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person\nmeetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android"

claims.claim: An in-person Facilitator note-taking session has no organiser.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in person Teams Rooms organizer unscheduled. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and the search excerpts; they say unscheduled discussions and console initiation, but do not say that the resulting session has no organiser.
claims.fix: Remove 'and no organiser' from the first sentence of Why it matters; retain 'with no meeting invite'.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The documentation does not establish that retention, eDiscovery and audit treat these in-person SharePoint Embedded notes identically to scheduled-meeting notes, including cloud-attachment collection.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms transcription room account meeting policy retention eDiscovery audit SharePoint Embedded. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms, facilitator-teams and purview/ai-teams-facilitator; none establishes identical treatment for room-saved Embedded notes.

claims.claim: Learn lists automatic eDiscovery cloud-attachment collection of Facilitator meeting notes as unsupported.
claims.quote: Facilitator's AI-generated notes for meetings aren't automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery because it isn't currently supported.
